scope: Sanitized transport metadata derived from physical steady AC3 and DTS captures; no source audio, captured compressed bytes, device identifiers, or raw edges are included

independent_evidence.physical_payload_check: Accepted D6 extracted payloads matched source payload frames byte for byte; independent FFmpeg decode with CRC checking returned zero without codec errors
independent_evidence.cross_path_check: Raw upper16 payload words were independently collected at literal F872/4E1F/Pc/Pd headers; complete D6 and D7 payload arrays were byte identical in order
independent_evidence.regression_payload: New deterministic words 0x4000 | ((word_index * 73 + Pc * 29) & 0x3fff); these are not captured audio or claimed valid compressed codec frames

limitations: The deterministic regression is derived synthetic transport evidence, not a recording replay or independent codec validation
Steady captures do not establish PCM/compressed transitions, gaps, physical reconnect or reacquisition
D7 PCM declaration conflicts with IEC headers; identical payload bytes do not authorize overriding that status declaration
EAC3 hardware evidence and calibrated clock or jitter measurements are not established by these artifacts
